verdict_reason: The provider is threaded through correctly and the IDM path is covered by idm-sign-in.test.js, but the optional provider parameter falls back to the stub without the caller saying so.

todos.issue: getOidcConfigWithRetry(logger, provider = defraIdProvider) takes the provider as an optional positional parameter that falls back to the stub provider. With two providers now, a caller that leaves it out (plugins/auth.js:21 calls getOidcConfigWithRetry(server.logger)) gets the stub's discovery document without saying so, and the call site does not show which provider it discovers. idm-auth.js:46 has to remember to pass idmProvider; dropping that argument would still start the server, but against the stub's endpoints. getOidcConfig(provider = defraIdProvider) in get-oidc-config.js:10 has the same default.
todos.fix: Must: every call to getOidcConfigWithRetry (and getOidcConfig) names the provider it discovers, and nothing falls back to the stub provider without being asked. One way: drop the default, make provider required, and change plugins/auth.js:21 to getOidcConfigWithRetry(server.logger, defraIdProvider) and refresh-tokens.js:11 to getOidcConfig(defraIdProvider).
